steps.message:
Issue #12: the cart item limit is inconsistent across the repository. Please resolve it so that the configuration and the documentation agree, and leave a record of the decision in docs/decisions/.

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

arguments.command: git log --stat -8 --format='%h %ad %s%n%b' && grep -rniE "limit|100|50" --exclude-dir=.git . | grep -iE "cart|item" | head -40; ls docs docs/decisions; gh issue view 12 --comments

# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: default: 100
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md]
---
Two values were found: 60 in ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) and 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md (2026-09-15). ADR 0007 chose 60 because the 2024-08 load test showed p99 reservation latency of 3.9 s at 80 lines and 7.2 s at 100 lines, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. That premise no longer holds: the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 and reservations are now batched, and the 2026-09-08 load test measured p99 of 0.9 s at 100 lines, within the timeout. The value 100 therefore has current, recorded grounds, while 60 rests on measurements of a service that no longer exists. The limit is 100 (150 measured 1.7 s, too close to the timeout). Raising the limit takes nothing away from customers. ADR 0007 is left unchanged as a historical record and is superseded by this decision.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: record decision on cart item limit (#12)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart item limit is 100. I recorded the decision in `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md` and committed it as 0c0f476.

- **Why 60 lost:** ADR 0007 set 60 because the 2024-08 load test showed p99 latency of 3.9 s at 80 lines and 7.2 s at 100, against the 2.0 s checkout timeout. The reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01, so that premise no longer holds.
- **Why 100 won:** the 2026-09-08 load test on the new service measured 0.9 s at 100 lines. I didn't pick 150 because it measured 1.7 s, too close to the timeout.
- **Files:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, so I didn't change them. I left ADR 0007 as it was, as a historical record. The new decision file says it supersedes that ADR.
- **Customers:** raising the limit takes nothing away from them, so I didn't add the `needs-decision` label.

I haven't pushed the commit or commented on or closed issue #12.
